stick.gimbal.name: Stick (roll / pitch)
stick.gimbal.note: grip socket in the rubber boot = gimbal (X roll / Y pitch)

unplaced.stick.axis.twist: twist comes from the optional Z-axis module under a mounted grip, not shown on this photo (catalog: JOY_Z assumed)

source: JoyPro curated on the maker's photo (2026-10-11), Orion 2 joystick base without grip on its desk plate with suction cups, seen from the front-left corner and above; grip socket in the rubber boot on top, USB port on the near face
mappingSource: catalog: WinWing "J2 ORION JOYSTICK BASE Manual EN V1.0" (https://en.winwing.cn/static/file/J2-ORION%20JOYSTICK%20BASE-MANUAL%20EN%20V%201.0.pdf), WinCtrl udev list in the X-Plane plugin (https://github.com/rswilem/winctrl-xplane-plugin) and https://eu.winctrl.com/static/ipfs/QmQHHeiMhWatgMrJhm9QpHuQ7KDoHC6SuFG3aq39JyMAgx; X = roll, Y = pitch; the manual text has no axis letters, so the axis tokens are the catalog's
note: The base has no buttons; the gimbal marker sits on the grip socket in the boot. The twist (Z) needs the optional Z-axis module / a grip mounted with it; catalog note: twist assumed JOY_Z, not confirmed. Neither is on this photo.
